manaNeeded: {U}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
notablePrerequisites: Synth Infiltrator has a power of at least 2.
description:
Cast The Master either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {U}{B} plus command tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Synth Infiltrator and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Synth Infiltrator to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Synth Infiltrator enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Synth Infiltrator by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.
